short_description: Pidilite's general-purpose synthetic resin wood adhesive for carpentry and lamination.
description:
Fevicol SH is Pidilite's synthetic resin adhesive for everyday woodworking. Carpenters use it to join and laminate plywood, solid wood, particle board, hardboard and MDF, and to fix laminates and veneers. It also bonds porous materials such as paper and cardboard.

Pidilite describes it as heat and water resistant and suitable for all climatic conditions.

Heat and water resistant
Suitable for all climatic conditions
High coverage
Easy to use

Carpentry and furniture joinery
Lamination work

Fixing laminates and veneers
Porous materials such as paper and cardboard

short_description: Waterproof wood adhesive for lamination in kitchens, bathrooms and other damp areas.
description:
Fevicol Marine is Pidilite's waterproof woodworking adhesive for lamination in places that get wet, such as kitchens, bathrooms and wall units. It bonds plywood, wood, particle board, hardboard, MDF, laminates and veneers.

Pidilite rates it for water resistance of up to 5 days and boiling-water resistance of up to 5 hours, with a setting time of 5 hours. Pidilite's coverage guide is about 7 laminate sheets per 5 kg.

Water resistance up to 5 days (manufacturer rating)
Boiling-water resistance up to 5 hours
Sets in 5 hours
Easy to spread, high coverage

Lamination in kitchens, bathrooms and wall units
Bonding plywood, wood, particle board, hardboard and MDF
Fixing laminates and veneers

short_description: Quick-bonding heatproof adhesive for lamination near heat, on vertical and curved surfaces.
description:
Fevicol HeatX is Pidilite's heatproof woodworking adhesive for lamination that will be exposed to heat. It bonds in 10 to 15 minutes and Pidilite rates it for heat resistance up to 170 °C.

It resists the spring-back of laminates on curved surfaces and, according to Pidilite, does not need masking tape, clamping, nailing or pressing, which suits vertical lamination. Coverage is about 2 laminate sheets per litre.
highlights:
Bonds in 10–15 minutes
Heat resistance up to 170 °C (manufacturer rating)
Resists laminate spring-back on curved surfaces
No masking tape, clamping, nailing or pressing needed
uses:
Lamination on surfaces exposed to heat
Vertical lamination
Laminating curved surfaces

short_description: Fast-tack waterproof adhesive that cuts bubble formation under large laminate sheets.
description:
Fevicol Hi-Per is Pidilite's anti-bubble, waterproof lamination adhesive. It is designed to reduce bubbles between plywood and laminate, especially with laminates thicker than 1 mm, and is suited to kitchen work.

Pidilite gives a tack time of 6 to 8 seconds and a setting time of about 2 hours.

Reduces bubble formation under laminates
Fast tack in 6–8 seconds
Sets in about 2 hours
Water resistant

Kitchen lamination work
